evidence_cards.content: The system must not allow closed or suspended accounts to sign in. If a user's account is closed or suspended, a popup message will appear telling the user: 'We're sorry, this account has been closed [suspended]. If you believe this is an error, please call or email Customer Care at (800) 123-4567 or Auctions@jtv.com.'

evidence_cards.content: If a registrant attempts to create a new account using an email address that already exists in the system, the system generates a response notifying the registrant that the email is already in use and asks if they need to reset the password for that account. If the user indicates 'yes', the system sends an email with a temporary password and advises the user to change it.
